description: A setup where Flyway scripts are the only way the schema changes and ddl-auto=validate checks the mappings against it.
A library that starts a real PostgreSQL container for a test, wired into Spring Boot with @ServiceConnection.
A test slice that loads only the persistence layer and rolls back each test, so assertions on SQL effects need flush().
A Course with its lessons treated as one unit, with cascade and orphan removal from the parent and a repository for the root.
The requirement that every entity deleted along with a parent also has @SQLDelete, or its rows are physically removed.
A sort such as title then id that gives every row one fixed position across pages.
A file that describes the local PostgreSQL service so one command gives every developer the same database.
